$comment: tvOS companion to the hub-generated panel-status-v1.json (vendored byte for byte; see SOURCE.json). The hub file holds only what the hub produces. This file adds, keyed by case name: the chip each hub case reads (DD22 copy, America/Los_Angeles), and the client-only cases (old hub, Date header missing / skewed, override expired by the hub's clock, hub unreachable, reconnected), each derived from a hub case by `from`. `remove` drops body keys, `headers` replaces the hub case's headers, `local_now` is the TV's own clock when the response arrives (default: the hub's Date), and `connection` is the client-side reachability. Same cases as the Android TV twin (G6a, androidtv #19); the copy is DD22's, which Android adopts in G6b. The override ends at 05:00:37, so 2h 42m 37s left reads "2h 43m left": the remaining time is cut to whole seconds, then rounded up to minutes (one rule for both TV apps).
